purpose: Accept durable guidance from trackers and learning cascades, preserve source provenance, and turn books and other resources into first-class study inputs without treating them as mastery evidence.
derivationRules: Every resource is preserved with its kind and provenance; books are never collapsed into generic notes.
Concepts create direct study targets; cascade concepts create derived scheduling targets only.
Resources may guide generated study material but do not count as learner evidence or mastery.
A later iteration may supersede a prior guidance packet without deleting its history.
Tracker-origin guidance must retain the originating opportunity/application record id so career gaps remain traceable.

trigger.reason: The target role lists stronger SQL fluency than current evidence demonstrates.

concepts.reason: Practice joins used in operational reporting.

resources.title: Learning SQL
resources.author: Alan Beaulieu
resources.note: Use relevant chapters as guided source material; do not infer mastery from reading.
